Hosts

Generated from the conformance run, not asserted here — so a divergence appears on this page the day it appears in the file.

Torbie

github.json may differ at settings, matchers

Owner-less references (repo#123) are resolved in host code -- a cached probe of the candidateOwners setting, falling back to `gh auth token`. Nothing in the format expresses that, so Torbie carries neither the setting nor the matcher it serves; without the probe every such preview would fetch repos//<repo>/issues/<n> and card a 404.

jira.json may differ at settings

`normalize` and `suffix` on a setting field are additive keys the Windows Terminal host adopted first. Per the unknown-keys rule they are harmless to a host that has not, so this is a version skew rather than a disagreement.

stith.json may differ at html

The html representation RUNS in Torbie and is compiled-but-disabled in Windows Terminal, which needs a feature flag and a WebView2 runtime it does not ship. The contract is identical; only whether it draws differs, and a host that ignores the key renders the fields list.

Everything else

Anything not listed above must match the canonical manifest exactly, as a parsed value. “Not synced yet” is not an allowance; it is the finding.

Built from the repo at aylith-labs/lintel — every page on this site is rendered from those files, so it cannot disagree with them.
